$comment: The manifest's "resolveAhead" (contract.json manifest.resolveAhead): the same manifests through the app's ManifestParser (PluginManifestResolveAheadTest) and the kit's validateManifest (resolve-ahead.test.mjs). `base` is merged under each case's `manifest`, and every case is a manifest Kino accepts: the field never refuses one. resolveAhead: what Kino honours. dropped: what the app logs and the kit's validate warns (after "resolveAhead: "), null when nothing was dropped. enhancementsDropped, when present: the enhancement blocks dropped, in order.

cases.name: apiVersion 1 reads it: it has no apiVersion of its own
the newest apiVersion reads it too
the string "true" is no boolean: dropped, never refused
cases.dropped: The "resolveAhead" field must be true or false; Kino ignores any other value

cases.name: a number is no boolean
cases.dropped: The "resolveAhead" field must be true or false; Kino ignores any other value

cases.name: an object is no boolean
cases.dropped: The "resolveAhead" field must be true or false; Kino ignores any other value

cases.name: a list is no boolean
cases.dropped: The "resolveAhead" field must be true or false; Kino ignores any other value

cases.name: beside "browser": true it is ignored
cases.dropped: The "resolveAhead" field is ignored beside "browser": Kino never calls this plugin's resolve ahead

cases.name: beside "browser": "pages" it is ignored
cases.dropped: The "resolveAhead" field is ignored beside "browser": Kino never calls this plugin's resolve ahead

cases.name: below apiVersion 6 "browser" is ignored, so the field stands
beside catalogOnly it is ignored
cases.dropped: The "resolveAhead" field is ignored beside "catalogOnly": Kino never calls this plugin's resolve ahead

cases.name: catalogOnly is named first when both are there
cases.dropped: The "resolveAhead" field is ignored beside "catalogOnly": Kino never calls this plugin's resolve ahead

cases.name: a value that is no boolean is named so even beside "browser"
cases.dropped: The "resolveAhead" field must be true or false; Kino ignores any other value

cases.name: an enhancement at an apiVersion that reads "browser" keeps the manifest's own reading
an enhancement block can't carry it: the block is dropped and the manifest's own value stays
enhancementsDropped: enhancements.14: "resolveAhead" can't be enhanced (only capabilities, screen, settings, panel, jobs, visualBrowser and slot)
